decision.summary: A sharp negative excursion in U (indices 615–630) with rapid recovery confirms a temporary offset on the vertical axis; horizontal components (E, N) show concurrent but smaller dips with incomplete recovery within the allowed context (≤699), so their temporary offset status is uncertain. No other temporary offsets are evident in the allowed context [575, 699].

intervals.observation: U shows a sharp multi-sample negative excursion starting ~615, reaching ~−4 MAD by 620–622, then rebounds sharply by 630 to near pre-event level; E and N show smaller concurrent negative dips (~−1.5 and ~−1 MAD) but recover more slowly—E not fully back by 630, N still depressed at 630. Return on U is clear; on E/N it is incomplete within allowed context. Thus, temporary offset in U is confirmed; in E/N it remains uncertain due to unobserved full return.

E and N remain below pre-615 baseline through 664 (last index in screened region), with no clear reversal or recovery trend; U has already returned by 630. Without observed return on E/N before 664, and no evidence of opposing motion to close the interval, status is uncertain for E/N over 615–664.
